description: This Java class provides services related to tax calculations within the OFBiz framework, specifically for handling tax adjustments, product tax rates, and tax authority data in the accounting module.

classes.name: TaxAuthorityServices
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating product tax rates, adjustments, and handling tax authority data within the OFBiz accounting module.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalcForDisplay
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total tax, tax percentage, and price with tax for a product, formatted for display purposes.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates tax adjustments for a list of products in an order, considering shipping, promotions, and tax authorities.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax authorities based on shipping address geo regions.

methods.name: getTaxAdjustments
methods.description: Generates tax adjustment entries based on product, store, and location data.

methods.name: setProductCategoryCond
methods.description: Determines the product category condition for tax calculations based on product data.

methods.name: handlePartyTaxExempt
methods.description: Checks and applies tax exemption status for a party, including inherited exemptions from parent entities.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the product price for a given product, store, and tax authority context.
